newsitem.title: USA: Mail-Well Inc renegotiates bank credit.
newsitem.headline: Mail-Well Inc renegotiates bank credit.

text.p: Mail-Well Inc said Friday it has renegotiated its $333 million bank credit, lowering the debt-to-capitalization ratio to 73 percent from 65 percent.
The new bank credit with Banque Paribas SA will consist of $233 million in senior secured financing and equipment financing plus a $100 million receivable securitization facility.
The company said a new $30 million revolving acquisition facility will provide funding for acquisitions of small- and medium-sized envelope and commercial printing firms.

"The new bank facilities will significantly reduce Mail-Well's debt, lower our interest costs and improve our earnings per share," Vice President and Chief Financial Officer Paul Reilly said in a statement.
The transaction is subject to completion and execution of the final bank credit facility agreements. It is expected to close in the fourth quarter.
